Sign in

Use http://this-host:8000 or https://this-host:8443 (browser warns until you install a trusted cert in the panel). Default admin / admin — change password after first login.

Change password

You must set a new password (min 8 characters) before using the control plane.

Until this step is done, the main tabs stay hidden.

Core services (systemd)

На хосте API, от имени easy-waf: systemctl show -p ActiveState, при пустом ответе — is-active.

Если везде unknown: нет systemctl в стандартных путях; D-Bus к systemd недоступен из процесса API (проверьте юнит: запись в /run, SELinux); либо после обновления не переустановлен юнит / не перезапущен easy-waf-api.

Live state on the API host as easy-waf. All unknown: missing systemctl, D-Bus to systemd blocked (unit needs /run writable, check SELinux), or service not redeployed/restarted after upgrade.

◇ Applications

Per-hostname security layers (WAF, GeoIP, CrowdSec, …). Use Config → Apply HAProxy after changes.

Add or update application

Editing existing app —

Restricted paths

Limit a URL prefix to LAN CIDRs only (e.g. Home Assistant /api). One CIDR per line.

▤ Certificates

TLS material metadata from PostgreSQL, ACME for issuance (acmed picks up after Request issue / Renew), and management HTTPS for the UI.

ACME (Let's Encrypt)

Registration email and staging flag. Use Settings → Load from server if fields are empty.

Management TLS (UI on port 8443)

Paste PEM full chain + private key to replace the bootstrap self-signed cert (hot-applied).

◎ Security

Profile presets

Reference for Applications → profile dropdown. Data from GET /api/v1/profiles.

Open this tab to load presets…

WAF rules

IP Blacklist

Local CIDRs and optional external lists → ip_blacklist.map. Sync refreshes the map; Apply HAProxy for a new config.

IP Allowlist

Trusted CIDRs bypass IP blacklist and per-app HTTP rate limits when enabled.

Bot protection

Blocked UA map is written on Apply HAProxy (Config).

GeoIP

When enabled, Sync / Apply resolve blacklist CIDRs to countries. ipinfo: optional GEOIP_IPINFO_TOKEN on the API host. maxmind: local GeoLite2-Country MMDB — see repository file docs/GEOIP.md.

✎ Settings

        
Service-specific options live under Certificates (ACME, management TLS), CrowdSec (LAPI / SPOE), and Security (WAF, IP lists, GeoIP). Use Load from server here to fill all tabs from GET /api/v1/settings.

        

          
        

        

          
Monitoring

          
When enabled, Prometheus can scrape GET /metrics on this management service. Access is restricted by management_allowed_cidrs only (no JWT). See docs/MONITORING.md.
